summary: Planban 1.1.4 substantially speeds up routine marketplace updates by safely reusing verified dependencies, falls back to a clean install whenever reuse is uncertain, and fixes updater command execution and verification on Windows.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban. Where direct update is eligible, use Update now; otherwise follow the agent-led fallback. Verify version 1.1.4, the plugin, and MCP tools; open an existing Board at its 127.0.0.1 URL; and confirm it remains readable and writable. Planban v1.1.4's dependency reuse accelerates later unchanged-dependency marketplace updates; the v1.1.3-to-v1.1.4 installation is still performed by the previous updater.
changelogSummary: Faster routine marketplace updates with verified dependency reuse, clean-install fallback, and reliable Windows execution.
